pages.text: $(bold)The forbidden ritual:$(0) the ultimate use of the Mother Altar — offer $(4)1x Life Fusion Ingot$(0) as the main item and 1 item on each of the 8 surrounding altars to condense four $(4)Forbidden Trinkets$(0). All four share one set of extension slots; once worn, their boons and their price both apply.$(br2)$(bold)Prerequisite:$(0) you must first build the $(l:akaishi:goat_altar)Tier 3 Altar of the Black Mother$(/l). A lower tier will not start the ritual even with a complete recipe.

pages.title: The Four Recipes
pages.text: $(bold)Shared template:$(0) main item = 1x Life Fusion Ingot; the 8 outer altars take $(4)2x theme organ + 2x base material + 2x gene sequence + 2x potion$(0).$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Touch of a Thousand Hands$(0): left arm + right arm, base material is Life Embryo$(li)$(bold)Quickening of the Cub$(0): 2x heart, base material is Life Embryo$(li)$(bold)The Mother's Gaze$(0): 2x eye, base material is Life Ash$(li)$(bold)Endless Gestation$(0): 2x viscera, base material is Life Ash$(br2)$(bold)Offering thresholds:$(0) organs must be $(4)tier III or above$(0) and neither polluted husks nor gibberish; gene sequences and potions must be at $(4)full purity 100$(0).

pages.title: Infusion and Drain
pages.text: $(bold)Threshold:$(0) all four recipes need a $(4)Tier 3 altar$(0) and a charge threshold of $(4)800,000 life energy$(0); the older Life Fusion Ingot recipe has no tier requirement and a 80,000 threshold.$(br2)$(bold)Automatic:$(0) once the altar is formed and the recipe complete it simply $(4)starts draining on its own$(0) — no redstone, no player action.$(br2)$(bold)Drain:$(0) every 2 seconds it scans all living beings (players included) within $(4)64 blocks$(0) and drains $(4)10%$(0) of their max health, up to 16 targets at a time, nearest first. Each health point yields $(4)1000 life energy$(0), capped at 5000 per target per strike. A target too low on health is drained dry and dies.$(br2)$(bold)Consequence:$(0) anything drained to death $(4)drops nothing, grants no experience and does not count as your kill$(0); the death message says its life was reclaimed by the Mother. Creative-mode players are exempt.

pages.title: Erosion and Locked Slots
pages.text: $(bold)Erosion:$(0) wearing a forbidden trinket accumulates $(4)erosion$(0), shown right on the item tooltip; the higher it climbs, the more often the wearer suffers warped vision and unnameable whispers.$(br2)$(bold)When it maxes out:$(0) the organ slots are $(4)permanently locked$(0) — all four Akaishi extension slots turn to gibberish, blocking both implantation and removal, and the related modification machines and the rejection neutraliser stop working. The trinket itself has become a source of contamination.$(br2)$(bold)Removing it:$(0) before it maxes out, normal interaction removes the trinket as usual; once maxed out, deal with the consequences first.
Slots and body modification live in $(l:akaishi:life_body)Body Modification$(/l); organ quality and affinity in $(l:akaishi:life_organs)Organ Research$(/l).
